snippet.title: PlayStation - Genei Tougi - Shadow Struggle (1996)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Genei Tougi: Shadow Struggle is an Action game, developed by Racdym and published by Banpresto, which was released in Japan in 1996.
